steps.title: Prepare buffers and set temperature
steps.instruction: Prepare SPM Buffer, VHB Buffer, and HDQ Binding Buffer according to the “Preparing Reagents” section of the Mag‑Bind Blood & Tissue DNA HDQ 96 Kit protocol, and set a heat block, incubator, or water bath to 56 °C.

steps.title: Make AL/Proteinase K mastermix
steps.instruction: For one 96‑well plate, combine 500 µL AL Buffer and 40 µL Proteinase K Solution per sample (total 52.8 mL AL Buffer and 4.2 mL Proteinase K, 10 % excess). Prepare only the volume that will be used within 4 hours.

steps.title: Homogenize filters
steps.instruction: Transfer each filter into a Qiagen collection microtube (5 mm stainless‑steel bead) containing 500 µL TL buffer and 40 µL Proteinase K.

steps.title: Add magnetic beads to first plate
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL HDQ magnetic beads to one KingFisher Deep‑Well plate.

steps.title: Add binding buffer to plates
steps.instruction: Add 320 µL HDQ Binding Buffer to each of the two KingFisher Deep‑Well plates.

steps.title: Transfer lysate and mix
steps.instruction: Transfer 200 µL lysate twice (total 400 µL) into each Deep‑Well plate that already contains 230 µL AL Buffer, then pipette‑mix.

steps.title: Centrifuge plates
steps.instruction: Spin the plates at 4 000 × g for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Add RNase A
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL RNase A to each well.

steps.title: Process second plate (no beads)
steps.instruction: Repeat the binding‑buffer addition and lysate transfer steps for the second Deep‑Well plate that does not contain HDQ magnetic beads.

steps.title: First magnetic separation
steps.instruction: Place each plate on a magnetic separation device until the HDQ particles are completely cleared from solution (room temperature).

steps.title: Discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Remove the plate from the magnet and aspirate the cleared supernatant without disturbing the magnetic particles.

steps.title: VHB wash (first)
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL VHB Buffer (pre‑diluted with 100 % ethanol) to each well, vortex 15 seconds, place on magnet until particles clear, then aspirate and discard supernatant.

steps.title: SPM wash
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL SPM Buffer (pre‑diluted with 100 % ethanol) to each well, vortex 15 seconds (complete resuspension is critical), place on magnet until particles clear, then aspirate and discard supernatant.

steps.title: VHB wash (second)
steps.instruction: Repeat the VHB wash: add 600 µL VHB Buffer (ethanol‑diluted), vortex 15 seconds, magnetically separate, and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL Elution Buffer (pre‑heated to 70 °C or use nuclease‑free water at 70 °C) to each well, vortex briefly, place on magnet until particles clear, then aspirate and discard the cleared supernatant.

steps.title: Optional water rinse
steps.instruction:
Choose one of the following:
A) While the plate remains on the magnet, add 500 µL nuclease‑free water, leave on magnet 20–30 seconds, then aspirate (do not exceed 60 seconds).
B) Keep the plate on the magnet for 1 minute, then remove residual liquid with a pipettor and dry the particles for an additional 10 minutes.

steps.title: Collect eluate and store
steps.instruction: Transfer the cleared supernatant containing purified DNA to a 96‑well microplate (not provided) and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Final vortex
steps.instruction: Place the plate on the magnetic device until particles clear, then vortex for 5 minutes (or vortex 15 seconds every 1–2 minutes for a total of 5 minutes).
